market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Dow below key level, oil spike from Iran, and inflation fears cap upside. Gold and defensives outperform. Asian markets mixed on China rebound vs. yen volatility. Expect elevated VIX and sector rotation toward energy, gold, and quality financials.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle intact despite circular financing concerns. Asian EM structural growth (India, China services) supports medium-term equity returns. Energy transition and ag-sector upgrades offer thematic upside. Key risk: prolonged Iran conflict or JGB debt crisis.
